bullets.text: Thirty villages in Thiruvallur faced a four-hour power outage, and the office should monitor electricity restoration efforts.
Police seized illegal drugs in Avadi, and the office should watch local enforcement updates on anti-drug operations.
Residents complained that Thiruttani municipality failed to provide drinking water connections for thirteen years, and the office should follow up with local administration.
Police arrested two people for stealing jewelry and cash from a fish vendor's house in Melathiruttani, and the office should note the crime updates.
The Southern Rising Summit 2026 debated whether artificial intelligence can replace the human brain, and the office should review discussions on human intelligence versus AI.
Karnataka launched a CM Dashboard to track government schemes and departmental performance, and the office should observe this digital governance initiative.
